newsitem.title: USA: Nashville Country files for 2.25 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nashville Country files for 2.25 mln shrs.

text.p: Nashville Country Club Inc said Friday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission pursuant to place about 2.25 million common shares with selected institutional investors.
The company said it will use the proceeds to fund the acquisition of a group of related entities that produce concerts and manage merchandising for concerts and sports events.

Nashville Country Club, headquartered in Tennessee, is a diversified entertainment company that operates resort hotels and restaurants and that also produces concerts, corporate entertainment and entertainment marketing events.
